item.title: Data-Engineering-Technologies
item.description: Data engineering is a crucial field that enables organizations to derive value from their data. It involves the design, construction, and maintenance of systems for collecting, storing, and processing data, with the aim of making it available for use in business intelligence, analytics, and machine learning.
